name: fqc-slack
description: Slack notifications for FQC-ARR (heartbeats, per-role status, run banners) wrapping the slk CLI. Posting to the pinned status channel is low-risk (not a data write); the channel is set once in agent config, not chosen per run. Message text is identifier-first with no agent self-signature.

securityScheme.note: Sana holds the Slack app token. Fallback local: slk CLI Keychain session. Directory resolution replaces slack_directory.json.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Post a short status line to the pinned FQC-ARR channel. Not a governed data write; no HITL gate.

text.description: Identifier-first status text; no agent signature.

channel.description: Optional override; defaults to the pinned channel from agent config.

tools.name: post_thread
tools.description: Reply in a per-role thread under the run banner (activity feed mirror of the Tasks inbox).
